title: Walk to Hillsboro + Music Row •  Sylish Suite
description:
Welcome to Belcourt by AvantStay. Named for the historic movie house around the corner, this bright, easygoing retreat sits in the heart of Hillsboro Village — Nashville's most walkable pocket of shops, cafés, and kitchens, with Vanderbilt and Belmont just up the street.

☕ Steps to Hillsboro Village shops & cafés
🎬 Named for the nearby historic Belcourt Theatre
🌿 Shared building terrace + in-unit laundry

The space
Settle into Belcourt 313, a stylish two-bedroom retreat tucked into the heart of Hillsboro Village — one of Nashville's most walkable pockets and a neighborhood that's long been a favorite of locals, students, and musicians alike. This is the kind of stay where you can roll out of bed, grab coffee at a neighborhood café, and be at brunch before the line at Pancake Pantry even starts to curl around the block.

Inside, the space strikes an easy balance between polished and lived-in. Warm wood accents, curated artwork, and soft, bright interiors give the home a relaxed-but-elevated feel. The open living area is built for winding down after a full Nashville day — stream a movie, pour a glass of something, or regroup with friends before heading back out. The queen sleeper sofa adds flex space for a fifth guest or a kid crashing after a late night.

Both bedrooms come with their own ensuite bath, so couples and friends traveling together can spread out without negotiating over the shower. The primary has a king; the second, a queen. The fully equipped kitchen handles everything from a quick breakfast spread to a late-night snack run after Broadway. In-unit laundry, central heating and AC, and fast Wi-Fi round out the essentials.

Arrivals are easy too — the building has elevator access and paid on-site parking, a real win in a neighborhood where street spots get snapped up fast. Head up to the shared outdoor terrace for a morning coffee, a sunset hang, or a quiet moment between plans.

Step outside and Hillsboro Village is yours to wander. Grab a biscuit at Biscuit Love, duck into the indie bookstores and boutiques along 21st, or catch a film at the historic Belcourt Theatre — the neighborhood's namesake. Vanderbilt and Belmont University are minutes away, Music Row is a quick hop, and downtown Nashville and Broadway's honky-tonks are under 15 minutes by car. Belmont Mansion and Centennial Park (home of the full-scale Parthenon replica) are both nearby for a slower, more scenic afternoon.

Whether you're in town for a concert, a college visit, a long weekend, or a stretch of remote work, Belcourt 313 puts you right where Nashville's quieter charm and its louder energy meet.

There's a reason Nashville, TN has become one of the country's most loved southern cities. With its vibrant nightlife, country music scene, and incredible food, "Nashvegas" is a top destination for people simply looking to have a good time- which means lots of drinking and eating. Visitors flock to Broadway, a street lined with multi-level bars playing live music and serving BBQ. You might get stuck in traffic behind party bikes called Pedal Taverns, but you're more likely to cheer them on than get road rage because having fun is part of the culture in Nashville.

While all units provide the same great amenities and overall experience, each space has its own unique layout and décor. Some units include balconies that overlook the terrace, while some include outdoor spaces that lead directly to the terrace. The exact unit you receive may vary slightly from the photos.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we’re at your fingertips.

Experience Nashville, AvantStay style.

Other things to note
Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- This unit has a balcony overlooking the common rooftop area.

Parking Details:

• Parking is available for a flat $14/day with in/out privileges when you register your vehicle on your check-in day before arriving at the garage.
• Park only in the gated section of the garage. Enter via the ramp on Belcourt Avenue directly across from the Belcourt Theatre at 2111 Belcourt Ave, between Blo and Anzie Blue. Do not enter or park in the garage section accessed from the back alley. Your parking registration is not valid there, and you may receive a ticket.
